title: L2-L3 radial disc bulge at four landmarks, intact (Heuer 2008)

quantity.name: disc bulge
quantity.definition: relative radial displacement (L2 translation removed) of outer annulus at mid disc height; + outward, - inward; median (min-max) of 6 specimens; 'site' field = landmark

source.authors: Heuer F, Schmidt H, Wilke HJ
source.sample: 6 human cadaveric L2-L3 FSUs from the same donor spines as Heuer 2007a/b (which used L4-L5)

protocol.summary: 15 min 500 N axial preconditioning; L3 caudal end fixed to laser-scanner base, L2 cranial end on the spine-tester gimbal (unconstrained); pure moments 2.5, 5, 7.5 Nm in flexion/extension, lateral bending, axial rotation (and 500 N axial compression for scans); RoM evaluated from the 2nd loading cycle; for surface scans specimens were driven to the maximal deflection and held (4 s laser scan). No preload during bending.
how_to_simulate: Fix the caudal half of L3; L2 free (no preload)
Apply pure moments 2.5, 5, 7.5 Nm in flexion, extension, right lateral bending, left axial rotation (and 500 N axial compression for bulge/strain)

Report L2-L3 rotation at peak moment; for bulge report radial outer-annulus displacement at mid disc height at the anterior, left lateral, left posterolateral, posterior points (translation of L2 removed); for strain report max/min outer-annulus surface strains (axial z-z, circumferential phi-phi)
Defects cumulative: (1) remove vertebral arches incl. SSL/ISL/FL and facets, (2) remove PLL and ALL, (3) nucleotomy (right posterolateral oblique incision, 2.9 g)
protocol.notes: Stage order: INTACT -> w/oVA -> w/oALL (PLL+ALL removed) -> w/oNUC. Values absolute (deg, mm, %), not % intact. Bulge sign: + outward, - inward. Posterior/posterolateral landmarks not accessible in intact specimens.

extraction.check_notes: Signs transcribed from 300-dpi render and verified against the text-layer minus glyphs (\x02) for all 28 rows: 0 mismatches. Intact posterior/posterolateral not measured. | verified 2026-11-12 sign check: OK (Tables 1-2 p3 and Table 3 p4 images: all values and signs match, incl. negative min strains and inward bulging)

shared_sample_with: heuer2007a: same donor spines (different level, L4-L5) - donor-level overlap only
wilke2025: Heuer 2008b (n=6 L2-L3) listed in Wilke 2025 Table 4 - pooled in Wilke 2025 L2-L3 data
